cells.rationale: DGS10 printed 5.24% on Oct 1 (H.15) after a sharp September climb to multi-decade highs, and the market 10-year closed near 5.28% on Oct 2 despite a weak September payrolls report, leaving the level a few basis points above the 5.24% threshold. With roughly a week of trading and recent daily moves of 5-10bp, the outcome is near a coin flip tilted slightly toward above; weaker jobs data trims Fed-hike pressure while FOMC minutes and supply concerns keep upside risk. Oct 12 is Columbus Day, when SIFMA recommends a full bond-market close, so DGS10 will most likely have no value and the question should resolve as cancelled; this probability is conditional on a value being published.

note: Recorded before every entry's cutoff; scored as a separate method.
